description: Create a new release on a track. Specify version code, release notes, and optionally staged rollout percentage.

autoFillLocales.description: Auto-fill missing locale release notes from en-US (default: true)

releaseNotes.description: Object of locale -> release notes. E.g., {"en-US": "Bug fixes", "tr-TR": "Hata duzeltmeleri"}

status.description: Release status: draft, inProgress (staged rollout), or completed (full rollout)

userFraction.description: Rollout fraction (0.01-1.0). Only used when status is inProgress.

versionCode.description: Version code of the AAB/APK already uploaded to Google Play

name: gpc_create_release
